blocks.text: Paul Dirac ne 1928 mein peshgoi ki ke bunyadi zarron ke antiparticles hote hain. Antiparticles ke rest masses un ke mutabiq zarron jitne hote hain magar charges ulat. Maslan positron electron ka antiparticle hai, e+ se zahir; us ka rest mass electron jitna hai magar us par usi miqdar ka musbat charge hai. Positron pehla daryaft hone wala antiparticle tha, jise Anderson ne 1932 mein cloud chamber tajrube mein dekha; yeh antiparticle ki pehli tajrubati daryaft thi, aur is ke baad bohat se antiparticles mile. Antiparticle aam taur par harf ke oopar lakeer (bar) se likha jata hai, maslan antiproton p-bar aur antineutrino nu-bar.

Bohat se daryaft shuda zarron mein quarks aur leptons ko bunyadi zarre, jinhein elementary particles bhi kehte hain, tasleem kiya gaya hai, aur in ke bhi antiparticles hain. Is daryaft par Dirac aur Anderson ko Physics ka Nobel Prize mila, Dirac ko 1933 mein aur Anderson ko 1936 mein; 1955 mein Segre aur Chamberlain ne particle accelerator se antiproton daryaft kiya aur 1959 mein Physics ka Nobel Prize paya (Interesting Information). Particle accelerator bohat bari machine hai jo electrons, protons ya ions jaise charged zarron ko intehai zyada energy aur light ki speed ke qareeb speed tak tez karti hai; linear accelerators, cyclotrons aur betatrons aham accelerators hain (For Your Information).

items: Cosmic rays khala se aane wale zyada energy ke zarre hain jin ke source na-maloom hain, shayad Suraj ya doosre sitare. Yeh zyada tar protons, neutrons aur bhaari nuclei hain jo Zameen par musalsal barste hain; fiza ki gason ke atoms se takra kar yeh secondary zarron ki barish (showers) banate hain jo hum par har waqt barasti hai.

Jab uranium-235 jaise na-paidar radioactive element ke nuclei nuclear reactors mein fission karte hain to neutrons, neutrinos, alpha particles, photons, electrons aur positrons jaise mukhtalif zarre kharij karte hain.

Jab electrons aur protons jaise charged zarron ko tez kar ke hydrogen jaise nishane par mara jaye to woh aapas mein aamne saamne bhi takra sakte hain; in reactions ke malbe mein pions, kaons, muons aur antiprotons tak hote hain.

blocks.text: Pair production tab hoti hai jab gamma-ray photon (zyada energy ka photon) atomi nucleus ke qareeb se guzarta hai: electron-positron jora kharij hota hai (Fig. 12.1). Linear momentum baqi rakhne ke liye nucleus jaise teesre zarre ki maujoodgi zaroori hai, is liye pair production khali space mein nahi ho sakti (Do You Know). Mass-energy masawat ke mutabiq photon ki kam se kam energy bane hue zarron ki rest mass energies ke majmooe ke barabar honi chahiye: electron-positron jore ke liye 2 m0 c^2 = 1.02 MeV, jis ki tajrubati tasdeeq ho chuki hai. 1.02 MeV se kam energy ka gamma photon jora nahi bana sakta, jabke 1.02 MeV se zyada ka photon jora banata hai aur zaid energy zarron ki kinetic energy ban jati hai. Pair production charge, momentum aur energy ki baqa ke qawaneen poore karti hai.

blocks.alt: Kam az kam 1.02 MeV tawanai wala lehrdar gamma photon baen se aa kar nucleus tak pohanchta hai. Wahan se electron aur positron mukhtalif simton mein urte hain. Caption kehta hai tawanai mass mein badalti hai: h f = 2 m c^2 jama kinetic energy.
blocks.caption: Nucleus ke qareeb photon se electron-positron joray ka banna (Figure 12.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Annihilation pair production ka ulat amal hai. Jab electron aur positron milte hain to do gamma-ray photons mein fana ho jate hain (Fig. 12.2, print mein Fig. 12.4 ka hawala): e- + e+ -> gamma + gamma. Har gamma photon ki energy 0.51 MeV hai, jo electron ya positron ki rest mass energy E = m0 c^2 ke barabar hai. Annihilation mein energy aur momentum baqi rehte hain. Electron-positron ke ilawa doosre zarre aur un ke antiparticles bhi fana ho sakte hain, jaise proton aur antiproton, lepton aur antilepton, quark aur antiquark. CERN mein zyada energy ke takraon ne dikhaya ke takrate zarron ka kuch mass Einstein ki equation ke mutabiq electromagnetic radiation ban jata hai aur bacha mass naye subatomic zarron ki shakal mein zahir hota hai (Fig. 12.3, zyada energy ka proton-proton takrao jis se 18 naye zarre bane).

blocks.alt: Baen se electron aur daen se positron darmiyan mein mil kar khatam (annihilate) ho jate hain. Do lehrdar gamma photons, har aik 0.51 MeV, ulti simton mein urte hain, aik oopar aur aik neeche.

rows: kam az kam 2 m0 c^2 = 1.02 MeV; zaid energy kinetic ban jati hai

blocks.prompt: Kya 20 keV energy ke photons se pair production ho sakti hai (short question 12.8)? Electron-positron jora ek photon mein decay kyun nahi ho sakta (short question 12.13)?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Electron aur positron banane ke liye kam az kam 2 m0 c^2 = 1.02 MeV chahiye, aur 20 keV is se kahin kam hai. Ek photon momentum nahi le ja sakta: jis frame mein jora aaram mein ho us ka kul momentum sifar hai, magar ek photon ka hamesha momentum E/c hota hai, to momentum aur energy dono baqi nahi reh sakte; ulti simton mein chalte do photons sifar kul momentum ke saath energy baant sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Matter aur antimatter mein kya farq hai (comprehensive question 12.3)? Pair annihilation misal se samjhaiye aur tib mein is ka istemal bataiye (comprehensive question 12.4).
blocks.explanation: Antiparticle ka mass us ke zarre jitna magar charge (aur magnetic khusoosiyat) ulat hota hai: positron electron ka, antiproton proton ka antiparticle hai; antimatter antiparticles se bana hai. Jab zarra apne antiparticle se milta hai to dono fana ho jate hain aur un ka mass energy ban jata hai; electron aur positron ulti simton mein chalte 0.51 MeV ke do gamma photons dete hain. Positron emission tomography (PET) mein mareez ko positron kharij karne wala tracer diya jata hai; har positron jism ke electron se fana hota hai, aur mareez ke gird detectors ulte gamma photons ke jore pakar kar dikhate hain ke tracer kahan jama hua.

items: Dirac (1928): har zarre ka antiparticle, ek rest mass, ulat charge; positron e+ Anderson ne (1932) dekha; antiproton Segre aur Chamberlain ne (1955). Accelerators, cosmic rays aur fission bohat se zarre banate hain.

Pair production: nucleus ke qareeb kam az kam 1.02 MeV ka gamma photon e- aur e+ deta hai. Annihilation: e- + e+ -> 2 gamma, har ek 0.51 MeV; charge, momentum, energy baqi; CERN mein kuch mass radiation aur baqi naye zarre.
